notes: The NX4 is a lighting control console (DMX/RDM/Art-Net/sACN/ONYX X-Net), not a general-purpose AV room control processor; "control / Control processor" is the closest fit in the given taxonomy. Full port-level detail was taken from Obsidian's own official "NX4 Installation Guide" PDF (specifications + labeled rear-panel photos), cross-checked against the product page and other retailer listings (Full Compass, Stage Lighting Store) — all agree. Not rack-mountable (large desktop control surface, 928x431x149mm), so rackUnits omitted. Caveats: (1) The rear-panel photo/diagram in the official manual shows a 5th "DMX IN" XLR5 port plus two "WING 1"/"WING 2" RJ45 (EtherCon-style) ports for daisy-chaining external NX Wing expansion surfaces — both are visible on the physical unit but are NOT itemized in the manufacturer's own summarized "Connections" spec block (which counts only "4x DMX/RDM Universe In/Out" and "2x Gigabit EtherCon" network ports); link speed for the WING ports is not stated so no grade was assigned. (2) DisplayPort version (1.2/1.4/2.0) is never stated anywhere in official docs — only "up to 4K" — so grade was omitted per instructions rather than guessed. (3) The two "External Screen Power" outputs are actually 8-pin Molex connectors (12V DC, for powering the optional external touch displays); mapped to the closest available connector id "dc-barrel" since Molex isn't in the allowed list. (4) The 6.3mm (1/4") audio jacks' TRS vs TS wiring isn't specified; mapped to trs-6.35 as the closest common convention. (5) Mains input is a PowerCON True1-compatible "Seetronic" locking AC connector, rated 100-240V 50/60Hz 140W; mapped to "powercon". (6) USB ports (3x USB 3.0, 3x USB 2.0) are unlabeled/unnumbered on the chassis, so they are listed by type/count rather than unique names.
